description_en: Queries the databases that a user is authorized to manage
description_zh: 查询用户已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl32swayw7o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabasesForUser

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to query
parameters.help_zh:
要查询已授权数据库的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据库实例名称
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the database to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_address

parameters.help_en:
The engine of the database to query. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain where the database to query resides
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询已授权数据库列表的网络域ID
parameters.name: network_domain_id

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the database. Valid values:

Public

Private
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
数据库地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

Comment.description_zh: 数据库实例的备注信息

DatabasePrivateAddress.description_en: The internal endpoint of the database. The value is a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePrivateAddress.description_zh: 数据库的私网地址，可为域名或IP地址

DatabasePublicAddress.description_en: The public endpoint of the database. The value is a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePublicAddress.description_zh: 数据库的公网地址，可为域名或IP地址

DatabaseType.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain where the database resides
NetworkDomainId.description_zh: 数据库所属的网络域的ID

Source.description_en:
The database type. Valid values:

Local: on-premises database.

Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance.

PolarDB: PolarDB cluster
Source.description_zh:
数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance or PolarDB cluster.

No value is returned for this parameter if Source is set to Local
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
数据库对应的RDS实例ID或PolarDB实例ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of databases returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库总数量
